title: Raw Antagonist
description: Antagonist push-pull supersets: incline push-ups and back extensions for a balanced upper body

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs, return feet together

exercises.name: Plank to downward dog
exercises.instructions: Alternate between high plank and downward dog position

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate cat and cow, breathe

exercises.name: Incline push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands on an elevated surface, easier variation

exercises.name: Superman
exercises.instructions: On your stomach, lift arms and legs simultaneously, hold 2s

exercises.name: Pike push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hips high in an inverted V, lower the head between the hands

exercises.name: Prone Y raises
exercises.instructions: On your stomach, arms in a Y shape, lift and hold 2s

exercises.name: Triceps stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm behind the head, pull the elbow with the other hand

exercises.name: Scorpion stretch
exercises.instructions: On your stomach, bring your foot toward the opposite hand while rotating

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions: Kneeling, arms extended forward, forehead on the floor, breathe deeply

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
